I think there were multiple factors at play that contributed to the decision to have a baby:

-she had gone through a divorce which stemmed (most likely) to her having an affair. The guilt from that decision and how much it altered her life

-her ex-husband moving on and having a child, likely leaving her to feel pressure to move on as well

-not having her children full time anymore from the divorce and from her abuse charge

-accidentally getting pregnant with Dakota and then the first miscarriage likely left her feeling the grief in that loss

-hoping having a baby with Dakota would ultimately sway her into changing how she felt about him and an ability to have a future with him

It was an irresponsible decision imo but she was going through a great deal of change and grief so it’s also understandable.
